about: Haldimand County is a single-tier municipality along the Grand River and Lake Erie in southwestern Ontario. Cayuga is the county seat; Caledonia, Dunnville, Hagersville, and Jarvis sit among farms rather than one urban core. Despite a legal “city” name, it functions as a rural county of river towns and Erie shoreline. About 49,000 people live in Haldimand County.
seoSummary: Grand River and Lake Erie municipality of farm towns, with Cayuga as the county seat.
